summary: Central Puerto S.A., an Argentine electric utility, reported via Form 6-K the repurchase of 50,000 of its own book-entry common shares (par value ARS 1 each) on BYMA. Trades occurred September 7, 2026 with settlement September 8, 2026 at an average price of ARS 2,202.90 per share, totaling ARS 110,145,418. The company stated acquisitions did not exceed 25% of average daily trading volume over the prior 90 business days. This represents an issuer tender/open-market buyback under Argentine Capital Markets Law. Watch for further repurchases and compliance with 25% volume caps.
